input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, the CONTRADICTED label remains appropriate.

H1 (one-time gains in operating income): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. The evidence shows that the large gains in Q1 2026 (approximately $15.6 billion from Anthropic investments) were recorded in "Other income (expense), net" (E7, E8, E11), which is below operating income on the income statement. No evidence was found of one-time gains that increased operating income.

H2 (Anthropic gains in operating income): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. E11 clearly shows the Anthropic-related gains were components of "Other income (expense), net" - specifically $4.5 billion in reclassification adjustments and $12.3 billion in upward adjustments to equity investments. E7 confirms these are in "Other income (expense), net," not operating income. This refutes any possibility that these gains inflated operating income.

H3 (other non-recurring benefits): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. E13 mentions a $347 million positive foreign exchange impact on operating income, but this is not a one-time item that overstates underlying profitability. No evidence of reversals, favorable adjustments, or other unusual benefits to operating income was found.

The claim states operating income "benefited from one-time items that overstate its underlying profitability." The evidence shows the opposite: one-time items in Q1 2026 were charges (damaged data centers, asset impairments) that reduced operating income by $447 million (E1). The large Anthropic gains were recorded below operating income and did not inflate it. Therefore, the claim is contradicted.
